chat.effort.title: Thinking level
chat.effort.hints.default: No extra setting; let the model decide
chat.effort.hints.low: Thinks less, answers faster; good for simple Q&A
chat.effort.hints.high: Thinks further; good for coding and multi-step tasks
chat.effort.hints.xhigh: Goes deeper; for complex coding and long tasks
chat.effort.hints.max: Thinks as hard as it can; slowest and most expensive
chat.effort.onHint: Turn thinking on (this model has no thinking levels)
chat.emptyHint: Describe a task; Deva reads and writes project files, asking permission as needed.
chat.notice.truncated: Replies kept hitting the output length limit or producing incomplete tool arguments, and automatic continuation didn’t finish, so I stopped. Send “continue”, or ask me to split the work into smaller pieces.
chat.notice.empty: The model returned nothing this turn. Try rephrasing or another model; if this chat has grown long, start a new one or compact the context first.
chat.notice.refused: The model declined this request (or the provider blocked it by content policy), so nothing came back. Try rephrasing, or switch models.
chat.notice.compacted: Conversation above compacted into a summary
chat.notice.compactedFirst: Earlier conversation compacted into a summary
chat.notice.compactedSteps: Previous {n} steps compacted into a summary
chat.notice.compactedStepsNone: Earlier steps compacted into a summary
chat.notice.compactNone: This conversation is still short — nothing to compact.
chat.notice.contextLimitLearned: The provider reports this model's actual context limit as about {n}; it will be used from now on to decide when to compact. You can adjust the context window under Settings › Models.
chat.notice.outputLimitRejected: The provider rejected the configured max output length; retried with {n}. You can adjust it under Settings › Models.
chat.notice.restored: Code was rolled back to an earlier checkpoint; the conversation is kept. Your next message will tell the model which files were restored.
chat.notice.aborted: Response stopped. Everything above was produced before stopping.
chat.notice.stepLimit: This run reached the step limit ({n} steps). Tool calls stopped and a summary was given; the task may be unfinished.
chat.notice.repeated: The same tool was called {n} times in a row with identical arguments and results, so tool calls stopped and a summary was given.
chat.notice.degenerate: The model kept repeating the same text verbatim, even after a retry, so the reply was stopped and the repeated part removed. Long context often causes this; try compacting or switching models.
chat.noModel: No model selected — add and enable a model under Settings › Models, then pick it from the model selector above the input box.
chat.noKey: This model has no API key — add one under Settings › Models.

bots.scanLead.telegram: Scan with your phone to open the bot, then tap Start to claim it.
bots.scanOpenLink: Open in Telegram on this computer
bots.scanNote.feishu: The account that scans becomes the owner of the bot, and the bot will message you once it is ready. Deva must stay running on this computer (keeping it in the tray is enough).
bots.scanNote.telegram: The Telegram account that taps Start becomes the owner of the bot. The token is stored encrypted on this computer only. Deva must stay running here (keeping it in the tray is enough) and be able to reach Telegram (set HTTPS_PROXY or similar env vars if you need a proxy).

bots.inviteHint.telegram: Ask them to send this to the bot in a direct chat on Telegram:
bots.removeUserConfirm: This account will no longer be able to control Deva through the bot.

bots.scopeHint.sessions: Only the selected chats (including scheduled-task chats) can be switched to and pushed; Chats created from your phone are added automatically.
bots.usageText: Just send a message to continue the current conversation. Commands: /new, /list, /use <n>, /stop, /status, /help. Plan reviews, questions and scheduled-task results arrive as cards.
bots.security: Security note: allowed accounts can make Deva read and write files and run commands on this computer, with the same permissions you have here. The bot only answers direct messages; group chats are ignored.
bots.deleteConfirm.feishu: The bot will be disconnected and stop working on your phone. The app on the Feishu Open Platform is not deleted; you can remove it there yourself.
bots.deleteConfirm.telegram: The bot will be disconnected and stop working on your phone. The bot itself is not deleted from Telegram; use /deletebot with @BotFather to remove it.
